intro.title: Residential & Commercial Painting
intro.mainText: A quality paint job does more than change a color — it refreshes the entire feel of a space. VV Renovation provides clean, detail-focused painting services for homes, offices, commercial interiors, and renovation projects.
intro.secondaryText: We work with homeowners, builders, designers, and property managers across the Greater Vancouver Area to deliver smooth finishes, consistent color, and professional results from preparation to final coat.

steps.text: We review your space, discuss your goals, help with color direction if needed, and prepare a clear estimate for the project.

steps.title: Final Review

items.question: Do you provide residential and commercial painting?
items.answer: Yes, we provide both residential and commercial painting services across the Greater Vancouver Area.

items.question: Do you prepare the walls before painting?
items.answer: Absolutely. Surface preparation is a key part of the job and may include patching, sanding, caulking, priming, and protecting nearby areas.

items.question: Can you help with color selection?
items.answer: Yes, we can help guide you toward color choices that fit the lighting, function, and style of your space.

items.question: How long does a painting project take?
items.answer: Timelines depend on the size of the space, condition of the surfaces, and scope of prep work, but many projects are completed within a few days.

items.question: Do you keep the site clean during the job?
items.answer: Yes, we work carefully, protect surrounding surfaces, and clean up after the project so the space feels finished and ready.

items.question: Do you serve all of Greater Vancouver?
items.answer: Yes, we provide painting services across Vancouver and surrounding areas including Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, New Westminster, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, White Rock, North Vancouver (City), North Vancouver (District), West Vancouver, Delta, Langley (City), and Langley (Township).
